title: cyperus diffusus var. chorisanthus
intro: Cyperus diffusus var. chorisanthus, commonly known as Chorisanthus or Chorizanthe, is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Chorisanthus are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Chorisanthus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
